name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Exhibit looks at how the Declaration of Independence evolved
changes.summary: A new exhibit, The Declaration's Promise, celebrates America's independence and showcases how phrases such as "all men are created equal," evolved. Nikole Killion has more.

changes.title: Fire departments work to get rid of cancer-linked foam extinguisher: "It was like sitting on a bomb"
changes.summary: Fire departments across the U.S. are changing how they extinguish fires. For decades, they used foam that contained so-called "forever chemicals" that are now linked to cancer. More than a dozen states are now working to collect, remove and destroy all of it. Mark Strassmann has more.

changes.title: The World Is Cutting Ties With America. It’s Already Costing Us.
changes.summary: When other countries cut ties, Americans pay.

changes.title: U.S. and world leaders pay tribute to Lindsey Graham following sudden death
changes.summary: The senior U.S. senator for South Carolina died suddenly at 71 on Saturday.

changes.title: A Bible passage is at the center of a debate over how the U.S. should treat immigrants
changes.summary: A debate over the Bible verse Matthew 25 is pitting mainline pastors, Black protestants and the pope against evangelical politicians put on the defensive over President Trump's policies.

changes.title: What a Monopoly importer learned when it tried to make things in the U.S.A.
changes.summary: After getting hit with tariffs for the imported board games he sells, Jonathan Silva decided to see if he could produce a version of his Monopoly game in the United States. This is what he learned. (Image credit: WS Game Company).

changes.title: Politics chat: Lindsey Graham dies at 71, Congress back in session, U.S. strikes Iran
changes.summary: South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham's sudden death at 71 has shocked Washington. Once a fierce critic of then-candidate Donald Trump, he became one of the president's most consistent defenders.

changes.title: Younger Voters Are Propelling the Democratic Socialist Surge in New York
changes.summary: Age seemed to be the predominant factor in the Democratic Socialists of America’s primary wins in House races in New York City.

changes.title: Hard-Liners in Iran Want to Keep Fighting America
changes.summary: With much of their leadership killed in the war, Iran’s conservatives have sought to fill the void and intensify the fight against the United States.

changes.title: 40 million under alerts as heat dome peaks across western U.S.
changes.summary: Heat alerts were issued for millions across parts of the western U.S. Sunday as an unusually prolonged heat dome reached its peak.
